ONLY PEOPLE WHO SUPPLY A RESUME WILL BE CONSIDERED!

Vacancy address: NFR Holdings PTY LTD is seeking for experienced Peoples Performance Department Managers to join the team at McDonald's Restaurants at the locations in Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas.

Vacancy address Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas:

102 Shakespeare Street, East Mackay, Queensland 4740

23-39 Oak Street, Andergrove QLD 4740

Work type: Full time- 38h/week

Tenancy: Position is available full time 38/h per week

Salary: $80,000

Qualifications & Experience:

AQF Diploma and minimum one year of relevant work experience or at least three years of experience if no formal qualifications.

Position Summary

The People & Performance Department Manager is responsible for planning, directing and coordinating workforce capability development, operational performance systems and staff engagement initiatives within a high-volume restaurant environment operating on a 24-hour basis.

The role integrates responsibilities across workforce development, operational performance monitoring, facilities coordination, safety compliance and inventory management, ensuring the restaurant maintains high operational standards and staff capability.

Operating within a franchised hospitality environment, the position focuses on improving staff performance, operational efficiency, service standards and workplace culture, while ensuring compliance with organisational policies and operational procedures.

This is a managerial role responsible for coordinating operational systems, staff capability development and performance improvement initiatives, rather than routine supervisory duties.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Development and Staff Performance

• Design and implement structured staff training programs to ensure employees meet operational and customer service standards.

• Conduct internal workshops with Crew Coach teams and key crew members to support new product launches and ensure consistent procedures and product quality.

• Promote a high-performance workplace culture through mentoring, coaching and professional development initiatives.

• Monitor staff capability development and implement improvement strategies to enhance operational productivity.

• Promote the organisation’s open-door communication policy and support staff engagement initiatives.

Operational Performance and Business Analysis

• Analyse restaurant sales performance including product demand, store operational segments, service periods and seasonal activity to identify operational improvement opportunities.

• Develop operational strategies designed to improve efficiency, maximise production capacity and reduce operational downtime.

• Prepare operational reports and performance analysis for the Restaurant Manager, Licensee and Head Office.

• Support implementation of operational initiatives that improve productivity and service delivery.

Facilities, Equipment and Infrastructure Management

• Develop and coordinate preventative maintenance schedules for restaurant equipment and operational infrastructure.

• Conduct weekly operational walk-through inspections to identify maintenance and repair requirements.

• Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities with external contractors and service providers.

• Conduct monthly audits of IT systems and operational infrastructure to ensure functionality and compliance with organisational standards.

• Conduct quarterly audits of equipment and operational systems against company standards.

• Monitor equipment calibration systems to ensure operational accuracy and compliance.

Safety, Compliance and Risk Management

• Design and implement workplace safety training programs, including quarterly Safety Squad training initiatives.

• Monitor safety reporting systems and ensure safety compliance standards are maintained.

• Conduct periodic operational safety audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.

• Ensure employees comply with workplace safety procedures and organisational policies.

Inventory and Operational Resource Management

• Oversee stock control systems and inventory procedures to ensure efficient operational supply management.

• Conduct stock audits and analyse stock usage patterns to support waste reduction initiatives.

• Coordinate inventory ordering schedules and stock delivery planning.

• Monitor storage procedures to ensure compliance with FIFO stock rotation systems and food safety standards.

• Manage procurement of operational equipment and small-ware supplies.

Quality Standards and Customer Experience

• Promote a customer-focused service culture aligned with organisational standards.

• Ensure operational procedures maintain high product quality and service consistency.

• Implement quality monitoring systems designed to support customer satisfaction and operational standards.

Leadership and Organisational Representation

• Represent the organisation at official occasions, conventions, training seminars and industry events when required.

• Support the Restaurant Manager and Licensee in implementing operational strategies and improvement initiatives.

• Act on behalf of the Restaurant Manager or Supervisor during periods of absence to ensure operational continuity.

• Prepare ad hoc operational reports and analysis for senior management when required.

Qualification and Experience Requirements

The position requires:

• AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Business Management, Retail Management, Human Resource Management or related discipline with 1 year experience

OR

• A minimum of three (3) years of relevant managerial experience within a franchised hospitality or retail environment, demonstrating responsibility for operational management, workforce development and business performance.

Professional experience gained within high-volume franchised hospitality operations may substitute for formal qualifications where the candidate can demonstrate advanced operational leadership capability.

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold

Vacancy address: NFR Holdings PTY LTD is seeking for experienced Peoples Performance Department Managers to join the team at McDonald's Restaurants at the locations in Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas.

Vacancy address Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas:

102 Shakespeare Street, East Mackay, Queensland 4740

23-39 Oak Street, Andergrove QLD 4740

Work type: Full time- 38h/week

Tenancy: Position is available full time 38/h per week

Salary: $80,000

Qualifications & Experience:

AQF Diploma and minimum one year of relevant work experience or at least three years of experience if no formal qualifications.

Position Summary

The People & Performance Department Manager is responsible for planning, directing and coordinating workforce capability development, operational performance systems and staff engagement initiatives within a high-volume restaurant environment operating on a 24-hour basis.

The role integrates responsibilities across workforce development, operational performance monitoring, facilities coordination, safety compliance and inventory management, ensuring the restaurant maintains high operational standards and staff capability.

Operating within a franchised hospitality environment, the position focuses on improving staff performance, operational efficiency, service standards and workplace culture, while ensuring compliance with organisational policies and operational procedures.

This is a managerial role responsible for coordinating operational systems, staff capability development and performance improvement initiatives, rather than routine supervisory duties.



Key Responsibilities

Workforce Development and Staff Performance

• Design and implement structured staff training programs to ensure employees meet operational and customer service standards.

• Conduct internal workshops with Crew Coach teams and key crew members to support new product launches and ensure consistent procedures and product quality.

• Promote a high-performance workplace culture through mentoring, coaching and professional development initiatives.

• Monitor staff capability development and implement improvement strategies to enhance operational productivity.

• Promote the organisation’s open-door communication policy and support staff engagement initiatives.



Operational Performance and Business Analysis

• Analyse restaurant sales performance including product demand, store operational segments, service periods and seasonal activity to identify operational improvement opportunities.

• Develop operational strategies designed to improve efficiency, maximise production capacity and reduce operational downtime.

• Prepare operational reports and performance analysis for the Restaurant Manager, Licensee and Head Office.

• Support implementation of operational initiatives that improve productivity and service delivery.



Facilities, Equipment and Infrastructure Management

• Develop and coordinate preventative maintenance schedules for restaurant equipment and operational infrastructure.

• Conduct weekly operational walk-through inspections to identify maintenance and repair requirements.

• Coordinate repairs and maintenance activities with external contractors and service providers.

• Conduct monthly audits of IT systems and operational infrastructure to ensure functionality and compliance with organisational standards.

• Conduct quarterly audits of equipment and operational systems against company standards.

• Monitor equipment calibration systems to ensure operational accuracy and compliance.



Safety, Compliance and Risk Management

• Design and implement workplace safety training programs, including quarterly Safety Squad training initiatives.

• Monitor safety reporting systems and ensure safety compliance standards are maintained.

• Conduct periodic operational safety audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.

• Ensure employees comply with workplace safety procedures and organisational policies.



Inventory and Operational Resource Management

• Oversee stock control systems and inventory procedures to ensure efficient operational supply management.

• Conduct stock audits and analyse stock usage patterns to support waste reduction initiatives.

• Coordinate inventory ordering schedules and stock delivery planning.

• Monitor storage procedures to ensure compliance with FIFO stock rotation systems and food safety standards.

• Manage procurement of operational equipment and small-ware supplies.



Quality Standards and Customer Experience

• Promote a customer-focused service culture aligned with organisational standards.

• Ensure operational procedures maintain high product quality and service consistency.

• Implement quality monitoring systems designed to support customer satisfaction and operational standards.



Leadership and Organisational Representation

• Represent the organisation at official occasions, conventions, training seminars and industry events when required.

• Support the Restaurant Manager and Licensee in implementing operational strategies and improvement initiatives.

• Act on behalf of the Restaurant Manager or Supervisor during periods of absence to ensure operational continuity.

• Prepare ad hoc operational reports and analysis for senior management when required.



Qualification and Experience Requirements

The position requires:

• AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Business Management, Retail Management, Human Resource Management or related discipline with 1 year experience

OR

• A minimum of three (3) years of relevant managerial experience within a franchised hospitality or retail environment, demonstrating responsibility for operational management, workforce development and business performance.

Professional experience gained within high-volume franchised hospitality operations may substitute for formal qualifications where the candidate can demonstrate advanced operational leadership capability.

USVD Consultants Pty Ltd (ACN 666 075 065) ABN: 80 993 362 158 is a recruitment company having office at Bella Vista NSW 2153.

Our client Thinksupreme Pty Ltd (TSPL), ABN: 99 648 206 393 (Business name: Supreme Aluminium Windows) located at: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd Moorebank NSW 2170. Proudly Australian owned and operated for over 60 years, they have been Sydney's most trusted supplier of aluminium windows & doors. They manufacture a large range of residential and commercial windows and doors using top of the line materials and cutting-edge production technologies. They specialise in New Builds, Developments, Renovations, Office, Commercial or Industrial Windows & Doors.

Due to their business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit Machinist(s) in their Operations team on a permanent full-time basis.

Role: Machinist
No. of positions: Multiple, minimum 02
Reports to: Operations Supervisor
Location: Unit 3 78 Heathcote Rd MOOREBANK NSW 2170
Annual offered salary: AUD $82,000 - $88,000 base + Super (for a 38-hour work week)

Purpose of the role: We are seeking an experienced Machinist or may be two to join our operations team on a full-time basis. Set up and operate lathes, CNC, Milling, Grinding, Drilling & Turning machines to produce metal components to the specified tolerances, in accordance with technical drawings and safety requirements as per Australian standards.

As a Machinist, your main duties and responsibilities include:
•	Interpret engineering and technical drawings, sketches and specifications (including AS 1100/AS 1102 standards) to determine job requirements, tolerances and machining sequences.
•	Set up and operate lathes to perform turning operations, producing components to specified tolerances using a full range of lathe accessories.
•	Set and adjust computer-controlled (CNC) machines and processes, resolving technical difficulties.
•	Set up and operate milling machines to perform milling operations on components to required tolerances and specifications.
•	Set up and operate grinding machines to perform grinding operations and check finished components for conformance to specification. 
•	Set up and operate general workshop machines (drills, saws, etc.) for basic machining operations in a maintenance or jobbing environment.
•	Carry out mechanical cutting and holing operations using a range of cutting equipment.
•	Perform precision mechanical measurement, selecting and applying appropriate measuring instruments and interpreting results.
•	Perform general engineering measurements using mechanical measuring devices and visual inspection techniques. 
•	Use hand tools and portable/fixed power tools safely and correctly for a variety of general engineering tasks.
•	Use tools and equipment to manually produce components to precise dimensions and finishes on metallic and non-metallic materials.
•	Perform routine calculations, including percentages, ratios, proportions and averages, and interpret simple charts/graphs relevant to machining tasks.
•	Shut down and isolate machines and equipment safely in accordance with relevant Australian Standards and WHS legislation.
•	Carry out manual handling of materials and components in line with Safe Work Australia guidelines.
•	Operate fixed/moveable load-shifting equipment to move and position materials and stock.
•	Order and requisition materials, consumables and tooling as required for production and maintenance tasks.
•	Work safely with industrial chemicals, solvents, coolants and materials used in the machining environment.
•	Plan and prioritise daily work activities in line with established procedures and WHS policies.
•	Organise, record and communicate production, job and maintenance information using workplace systems (including computer-based systems). 
•	Participate in and contribute to environmentally sustainable work practices in the workshop.
•	Work effectively as part of a production/engineering team, contributing to team goals and quality outcomes.
•	Assist in providing on-the-job training and guidance to apprentices, trainees or other production staff.
•	Interpret technical specifications and equipment manuals to inform machining and maintenance decisions.
•	Comply with WHS procedures, quality systems and legislative requirements at all times.

Qualification & Licences:
•	Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade – Metal Machinist (First class) preferred.
•	At least 5 years of proven work experience in the above job role. 
•	Sound experience as Machinist in Metal fabrication environment. 
•	Well experienced of WHS requirements, particularly in manufacturing and steel fabrication environment. 
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications.
Skills:
•	Strong organizational and time management skills 
•	Excellent attention to detail 
•	Ability to multitask and physically fit
•	Process and results driven 
•	Team player; collaborative 
•	Resilient, patient and adaptable 
•	Enthusiastic, self-motivated 
•	Proactive & hard-working

Additional information:
•	Ability to work outside of normal business hours on occasion when delivering key orders. 
•	Ability to travel interstate, if required.

Position: Retail Store Manager
Location: Gold Coast Pacific Fair – Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, 2–30 Hooker Boulevard, Broadbeach QLD 4218?

Hours: 38 hours per week?
Salary: AUD $85,000–$90,000 per annum, plus superannuation

This advertisement is posted by Comandini Migration Services on behalf of Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd.

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.
* Ensure employees have a strong understanding of the brand, products and services.
* Monitor the store’s product assortment and provide feedback to Area Management and the Buying Team regarding customer and market demand.
* Oversee the overall presentation of the store.
* Maintain high visual merchandising and product display standards in accordance with company guidelines.
* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.
* Build a positive and supportive workplace culture based on trust, professionalism and accountability.
* Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, training and performance development.
* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, workplace health and safety requirements and other applicable regulations.
* Use relevant retail, customer relationship management and point-of-sale systems.
* Ensure employees are appropriately trained in all operational and digital systems.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
* Relevant experience managing a retail store or comparable retail operation.
* Demonstrated experience leading, developing and motivating a retail team.
* Strong knowledge of retail sales, customer service and store operations.
* Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage key performance indicators.
* Experience in stock management, visual merchandising and operational compliance.
* Strong commercial awareness and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to build strong relationships with customers, employees and business stakeholders.
* Experience using point-of-sale, customer relationship management and other retail management systems.
* The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.
